content: Workers at Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games won’t unionize, after the vote for a formal recognition agreement failed, with only 25 percent of votes in favor of unionization. The Independent Workers Union of Great Britain (IWGB) said that Rockstar workers in the union will continue organizing even without formal recognition. Voting ran from November 12th through 26th, covering the launch of GTA VI. If successful, the vote would have established a formal framework for collective negotiation with the studio over pay, overtime, bonuses, leave, and pensions, along with a right to consultation over future changes including AI implementation and layoffs. Without it, Rockstar won’t have an obligation to meet union representatives, though workers and union members can still lobby for change informally. “For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society - this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for,” IWGB said in a statement sent to The Verge. “Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen.” When Rockstar fired 31 IWGB members last year, the union accused it of “the most blatant and ruthless act of union busting in the history of the games industry.” That case has gone to a UK employment tribunal, with a judgment still pending. “We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we’ve built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI,” Rockstar head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe told Bloomberg News. “This result reflects our team’s strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we’re excited to build on all we’ve accomplished together.”

chineseContent: 在正式认可协议投票失败后，侠盗猎车手 VI 开发商 Rockstar Games 的员工不会加入工会，只有 25% 的票支持加入工会。英国独立工人联盟 (IWGB) 表示，即使没有得到正式认可，工会中的 Rockstar 工人也将继续组织起来。投票时间为 11 月 12 日至 26 日，涵盖《GTA VI》的发布。如果成功，投票将建立一个正式的框架，与工作室就工资、加班、奖金、休假和养老金进行集体谈判，并有权就人工智能实施和裁员等未来变化进行协商。如果没有它，Rockstar 将没有义务会见工会代表，尽管工人和工会成员仍然可以非正式地游说变革。 IWGB 在发给 The Verge 的一份声明中表示：“对于 Rockstar 任何相信更公平的工作场所、更公平的行业和更公平的社会的人来说，这不是一个撤退的迹象，而是一个加倍努力的迹象。” “我们的数百名同事投票支持 Rockstar 的工会，但遗憾的是，我们认识到我们还有更多工作要做，以建立理解并赢得更多同事的信任。我们已准备好努力实现这一目标。”去年，当 Rockstar 解雇 31 名 IWGB 成员时，工会指责其为“游戏行业历史上最公然、最残酷的破坏工会行为”。该案已提交英国就业法庭，仍有待判决。 Rockstar 出版主管 Jennifer Kolbe 告诉彭博新闻社：“我们对我们的团队、我们共同打造的文化以及《侠盗猎车手 VI》的推出感到非常自豪。” “这一结果反映了我们团队对继续保持直接关系、合作的大力支持
